run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T09:42:39Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by a chaos-mesh network fault between the shipping and quote services. frontend's own error spans (STATUS_CODE_ERROR, 5m rate) were exactly 0 from 09:20:39Z through 09:41:39Z, rose from 0.408/s at 09:42:39Z to ~1.71/s, and fell back to 0 by 09:55:39Z while its total span traffic stayed ~38-45/s. The errors are confined to the checkout path: frontend POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder; frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress; checkout HTTP POST and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder; and shipping /get-quote plus the shipping client span POST quote. checkout's PlaceOrder ERROR rate equals shipping's /get-quote and POST quote ERROR rates at every timestamp, while the quote service emitted only STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans and its span rate collapsed from ~2.9/s to ~0.13/s, i.e. most shipping->quote calls never reached quote. In the same minutes the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawned a new NetworkChaos every minute from 09:40:41Z and those objects reported 'Successfully apply chaos' for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b and otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt, with TimeUp/Recovered about 55s later, repeating. Pods were all Running and ready with 0 restarts (started 09:06Z), quote/shipping Services and Endpoints exist and select, no NetworkChaos of another kind (Stress/Pod/DNS/IO/HTTP/Time) appears in the event set, and all flagd feature flags are defaultVariant 'off'. Other services' error rates (accounting, cart, payment) were 0 through the window, so the failing dependency of checkout is shipping's quote call, not payment/cart/currency/product-catalog/email.

claims.text: frontend's own error signal deviated at 09:42:39Z: sum by status_code of rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend"}[5m]) was 0 for STATUS_CODE_ERROR at every point from 09:20:39Z through 09:41:39Z, then 0.408/s (09:42:39Z), 1.30/s (09:44:39Z), peaking 1.707/s (09:51:39Z) and back to 0 at 09:55:39Z; STATUS_CODE_UNSET traffic stayed roughly 38-45/s throughout.

Errors appeared only on four services and all at the same time: frontend, frontend-proxy, checkout and shipping error rates rise together from the 09:42-09:43Z samples, while accounting, cart and payment stayed at 0 and the quote service had no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series at all.

The error spans are the checkout path and nothing else: frontend POST /api/checkout, POST, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder; frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress; checkout HTTP POST and oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder; shipping /get-quote and POST quote. frontend GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect show 0 error rate.

checkout's failure is the shipping quote call: sum by (service_name, span_name, status_code) of rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{...}[2m]) shows checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR identical at every timestamp to shipping /get-quote and shipping POST quote STATUS_CODE_ERROR (0.433/s at 09:43:00Z, ~0.6/s mid-window, 0 at 09:52:00Z), with the same matching STATUS_CODE_UNSET values, while checkout's internal span prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart carries STATUS_CODE_UNSET only.

The quote service stopped receiving most of shipping's calls without erroring: quote's span rate fell from 2.9/s (09:40:00Z) and 2.7/s (09:41:00Z) to 1.3/s (09:42:00Z), 0.4/s (09:43:00Z) and ~0.17-0.47/s afterward, while shipping's own span rate stayed ~1.6-1.7/s; quote's POST /getquote, calculate-quote and {closure} spans all carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET, i.e. no error status on quote's own side.

The chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition (namespace chaos-mesh) spawned a new chaos object every minute from 09:40:41Z to 09:50:41Z (objects -nh2wt, -wg96t, -w588w, -r952x, -x4hvd, -m59h5, -sq968, -2c44x, -8h4xd, -xb6sh, -kx8th), and each NetworkChaos reported Started and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9', 'otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b' and 'otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt', followed about 55s later by TimeUp and Recovered for those same three pods.

The fault originates in the Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition: chaos is applied continuously to the shipping pod and both quote pods from 09:40:41Z, and exactly on that path the shipping->quote calls stop arriving at quote and the shipping, checkout, frontend-proxy and frontend error spans begin, then all return to 0 by 09:55:39Z after the last spawned object's duration expires.

Pod-level failure is not present: all 22 pods in otel-demo are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and lastState.terminated.reason <none>, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-d2vwq, checkout-5dccddf8bb-vz2zd, shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b and quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt, all with startTime 09:06:29-09:08:29Z (before the incident).

Service discovery is not misconfigured: the quote Service resolves to two endpoint IPs (100.96.2.155, 100.96.4.53) and shipping to 100.96.4.227, and the quote/shipping Service selectors are opentelemetry.io/name=quote and opentelemetry.io/name=shipping, so the request loss is not a selector/endpoint mismatch.

Rejected: a crash, OOM, eviction or rollout of the frontend/checkout/shipping/quote pods caused the errors. All pods are Running and ready with 0 restarts and no last termination reason, and they all started at 09:06Z, well before the 09:42Z alert.

Rejected as the cause: flagd feature-flag fault injection. The flagd-config ConfigMap lists only flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure, every one with defaultVariant "off", and none targeting shipping or quote.

Other checkout dependencies did not error: payment, currency, product-catalog, cart and email show no STATUS_CODE_ERROR in the window (only ad, fraud-detection and recommendation retain the ~0.0037/s background error level also seen before 09:41Z), so checkout's PlaceOrder failures are not attributable to them.

The partition acts by dropping shipping->quote packets rather than by delaying them: failed shipping client spans have no counterpart server span on quote (quote's successful span count equals shipping's STATUS_CODE_UNSET count) and quote shows no error status. The exact action (partition/drop vs delay), direction and duration are not verified because the NetworkChaos/Schedule specs are not readable with the available tools.

shipping's application log in the window shows ordinary Requesting quote / Sending Quote lines with no failures surfaced, consistent with shipping failing at the transport level toward quote rather than handling an application error.

Advise the platform owner to inspect (and if the demo fault is unintended, suspend) the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition: confirm its cron cadence, duration, action/direction and pod selector, since it re-applies a shipping<->quote partition every minute and keeps the frontend checkout path failing.

gaps: Jaeger traces_search returned no traces for frontend, checkout or shipping in 09:40-09:56Z, so span-metric series were used; no complete trace graph and no parent-child call edges were verified.

The NetworkChaos and Schedule custom resources themselves are not readable with the available Kubernetes kinds; their spec (action, direction, duration, cron, selector) and the last recoveries after 09:50:41Z are unverified (the event snapshot ends at 09:50:41Z).
Prometheus returned no rule named RequestErrorRate, so the alert expression, ratio definition and threshold could not be verified.

The frontend container wrote no log lines in 09:40-09:56Z (0 bytes read), so there is no frontend application-log evidence; log queries for error keywords on the shipping and quote containers returned no matching lines (the shipping error-keyword query returned status no_data, which is not proof of absence).

A query for NetworkPolicy objects in otel-demo returned nothing (no_data), so whether network policies exist in that namespace is unknown; the fault mechanism observed is the chaos-mesh NetworkChaos application.
rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count had no series for shipping/checkout/quote, so the gRPC/HTTP status code of the failing shipping->quote call was not directly observed.
No Alertmanager history or change-history integration is available, so who created or last modified the chaos Schedule is unknown.
next_steps: Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition and the spawned NetworkChaos objects (spec.action, direction, duration, cron, target selector) to confirm the intended experiment and whether it should still be running.
Verify the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition (expression, ratio vs absolute, threshold) in the Alertmanager/Prometheus pair that fired it.
If experiment traffic is not intended, review who applied the schedule in chaos-mesh and whether the shipping<->quote partition should be scoped or removed.
